name: YNAB open graph social card by ynab.com
description: A 1200×630 share card on a flat periwinkle-indigo field, split roughly 55/45 between a product visual and a headline column. The left cluster layers a simplified iPhone mockup — showing a believable app home screen with white rounded cards and lime amount pills — over an organic green blob, ringed with thin white and teal doodles (plus signs, sparkles, circles) that keep the flat background from feeling empty. The right column stacks a three-line rounded-bold headline in cream with a hand-drawn lime squiggle under the first word, a plain CTA line, and a cream wordmark with a green period pinned to the bottom-right corner. Hierarchy is carried almost entirely by scale and colour: cream-on-indigo for text, lime and teal reserved for accents and in-app money amounts.
